title: Aorus Engine OC Tool Crashes
fullDescription: Aorus Engine conflicts with other OC apps. Reinstall after removing Afterburner / Precision X1.

faq.a: MSI Afterburner works on Gigabyte cards.

title: Aorus PCB Cracking from GPU Sag
shortDescription: Heavy GPU bends PCB causing crack.
fullDescription: Heavy 4-slot Gigabyte cards have caused PCB hairline cracks. Use heavy-duty support bracket.

title: RTX 40 Card Not Detected with 12VHPWR
shortDescription: PC posts but no display from GPU.
fullDescription: 12VHPWR sense pins must be fully seated. Partial insertion blocks PCIe enumeration.

title: RGB Fusion Doesn't See GPU
shortDescription: Fusion 2.0 fails to list the GPU device.
fullDescription: Fusion 2.0 must run as admin and only one app can talk to GPU SMBus.

fixSteps.title: Reinstall RGB Fusion
fixSteps.instruction: Use Gigabyte Control Center to install fresh.

faq.a: Works on many Gigabyte GPUs as alternative.

title: Windforce Fan Grinds at Startup
fullDescription: Known issue with reverse-rotation center fan touching shroud at cold start.

fixSteps.title: Spin fans manually
fixSteps.instruction: Power off, gently rotate fans to redistribute lubricant.

title: Aorus Master OLED Display Blank
shortDescription: Side OLED on Aorus Master not lighting.
fullDescription: OLED uses Gigabyte Control Center service. Reinstall GCC.

fixSteps.title: Restart GCC
fixSteps.instruction: Services.msc > Gigabyte Control Center Service > Restart.

faq.a: Yes, GCC has presets and custom GIFs.

title: Code 43 in Device Manager
fullDescription: Driver corruption or seating; DDU clean install.

fixSteps.title: DDU + reinstall
fixSteps.instruction: Safe Mode > DDU > latest Nvidia / AMD driver.

title: Aorus Dual BIOS Mode Toggle
fullDescription: Switch reads on cold boot only. Hold power 10s.

faq.a: OC mode boosts power limit slightly.

fixSteps.title: Cap FPS
fixSteps.instruction: Use Nvidia Control Panel max FPS.

title: Memory Junction Temp 100C+
shortDescription: Older Aorus 30 series VRAM hits limit.
fullDescription: Aorus RTX 30 series often shipped with thin VRAM pads. Replace with thicker quality pads.
